# forge-dashboard-sdk-php

> A PHP client for forge-dashboard's REST API, generated from its OpenAPI
> spec with openapi-generator's `php` target and a Guzzle HTTP transport. It
> handles auth, retries and typed error mapping so callers don't hand-roll
> HTTP requests against the API themselves.

Requires PHP 8.2+ and a running forge-dashboard instance. Every endpoint
except `health`, `getVersion` and the two webhook receivers needs a personal
API token, passed to the `Client` constructor or via
`FORGE_DASHBOARD_API_TOKEN`. This site is the phpDocumentor-generated API
reference for the hand-written parts of the client; the generated
API/model classes it wraps come from forge-dashboard's own OpenAPI spec.

## Docs

- [API reference](https://alrayyes.github.io/forge-dashboard-sdk-php/): phpDocumentor-generated reference for the SDK's public surface.
- [Client](https://alrayyes.github.io/forge-dashboard-sdk-php/classes/ForgeDashboard-Client.html): the main entry point — constructs the SDK and exposes each generated API group (`settings`, `tokens`, `pullRequests`, `admin`, `sharing`, `auth`, `webhooks`, `dashboard`, `health`).
- [ApiError](https://alrayyes.github.io/forge-dashboard-sdk-php/classes/ForgeDashboard-Exception-ApiError.html): typed error wrapper around the generated client's `ApiException`, carrying the HTTP status and the API's own error message.
- [RetryMiddleware](https://alrayyes.github.io/forge-dashboard-sdk-php/classes/ForgeDashboard-Retry-RetryMiddleware.html): the Guzzle handler-stack middleware behind the client's retry/backoff behavior for `429`/`5xx` responses.

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/alrayyes/forge-dashboard-sdk-php): source, issues, and the pinned OpenAPI spec this client is generated from.
- [README](https://github.com/alrayyes/forge-dashboard-sdk-php#readme): installation, authentication and usage examples.
